authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat even-side faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 184-182 (even side, 1989 infill), 2024-12-11 overcast strip: one grey-brown brick block of 5 storeys, flat roof, regular two-light windows with white frames and dark lower panels, a glazed loggia stack cantilevered at the left end, a glazed balustrade over the shop storey, white courses at sill level. kinker-1985-infill on its own grid (the cluster agrees).
